messages:
Lena: FYI PR #5234 landed a change that broke the Console preview: embedded dashboard widgets render as plain code blocks in Netlify preview. Appears only on preview, local dev server (mkdocs) is fine.
Omar: Hmm, did the mkdocs extension update land in that PR? We recently bumped the sanitizer which strips unknown HTML attributes. Could be removing `data-widget-id` used by the embed renderer.
Yuki: I saw this too when QA clicked through the examples. Also the cost/latency table at the top has two columns swapped (cost vs latency) after I re-ordered headers in the markdown. Small but confusing.
Lena: Right. Reverting the sanitizer bump in the PR branch fixed the widget render in the preview. I created branch docs/5234/revert-sanitizer.
Omar: Proposal: add a docs-lint CI step that scans .md for `data-` attributes and validates they are in our allowlist. I'll open infra PR for a GitHub Action that fails fast.
Yuki: Also we should add a short migration note in the tracing hook doc for the param rename -> `trace_id_hex`. Lots of examples still show `trace_id` or `traceid`. I can submit a small follow-up PR that updates JS, Python, and Go snippets.
Lena: Please include a before/after snippet so customers can grep and replace quickly. Small example diff:```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Omar: Good. For the asset ordering bug (screenshots in gallery are out of order), looks like a filename normalization script changed hyphens to underscores. Netlify's gallery widget sorts by filename which caused re-ordering. I'll add a check to the docs CI to warn if filenames contain underscores.
build-bot: PR 5234 preview deploy failed: 422 MissingAttribute: `data-widget-id` removed by sanitizer. Netlify logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/33188/logs
Yuki: I'll update the tracing.md migration blurb and include links to SDK changelogs. Also will run a quick grep over docs to find remaining `trace_id` variants: `git grep -n "trace_id\b" docs || true` and `git grep -n "traceid\b" docs || true`.
Lena: Plan: 1) keep revert branch open and mark PR as changes requested; 2) Omar adds docs-lint action + underscore filename warning; 3) Yuki opens SDK snippet PR and the migration paragraph; 4) I'll re-generate golden screenshots (preserve hyphenated names) and push to docs/assets/screens/.
Omar: I'll try to land the lint action today; it should be non-blocking but helpful for previews.
Yuki: One more ask: add a short one-line note in the tracing doc that warns older SDK versions expect non-hex ids, and link to migration guide. Helps support reduce noise.
Lena: Agreed. Tagging @support-bot so they can watch for incoming tickets after the docs rebuild.
support-bot: Noted. Will escalate any customer reports of mismatched examples.
Lena: Thanks everyone 44d I'll re-run the preview once the lint is merged and the snippets are updated.
